WhyDigitalize.heroQuestion: Is your business as visible online as it is in your community?
WhyDigitalize.statText: of mobile users abandon a website if it takes longer than 3 seconds to load. In Georgia, most searches for local businesses happen on mobile.
WhyDigitalize.losingTitle: What happens without proper online presence
WhyDigitalize.losingIntro: Your reputation is strong offline. But if your business doesn't have a clear online presence:
WhyDigitalize.losing1: Potential customers choose competitors who are easier to find online
WhyDigitalize.losing2: Your strong reputation isn't properly represented where people search
WhyDigitalize.losing3: Customers can't easily verify your services and contact information
WhyDigitalize.losing4: Time spent answering repetitive questions via messages and calls
WhyDigitalize.losing5: Difficulty maintaining a professional image that matches European standards
WhyDigitalize.gain1: more confirmed appointments without increasing advertising costs (service-sector benchmark: clinics, beauty salons, consulting)
WhyDigitalize.gain2Title: A clear, trustworthy presentation of your services
WhyDigitalize.gain2: Professional online presence that supports your word-of-mouth reputation and makes it easier for customers to trust and contact you
WhyDigitalize.conclusion: Digital presence is no longer optional
WhyDigitalize.conclusionSub: It protects your reputation. It supports your word-of-mouth. It makes your business easier to trust. Your customers are already searching online—make sure they find a clear and professional representation of your business.

ClinicComparison.title: Same reputation. Different digital organization.
ClinicComparison.subtitle: Both clinics may have strong reputations offline. But their digital organization changes daily operations and visibility.
ClinicComparison.clinic1Subtitle: Works well when patient flow is small. Becomes difficult as demand grows.
ClinicComparison.clinic1Item6: Repetitive daily messages asking about price, treatments, hours
ClinicComparison.clinic1Consequence2: Risk of double-booking or missed appointments
ClinicComparison.clinic1Consequence4: Strong offline reputation but weak digital representation
ClinicComparison.clinic1Consequence5: Some potential patients never complete the booking process
ClinicComparison.clinic1Consequence6: Staff time is spent on scheduling instead of patient care
ClinicComparison.clinic2Item2: Local SEO optimized (appears in searches like "aesthetic clinic Tbilisi")
ClinicComparison.clinic2Item7: Clear presentation of services and pricing
ClinicComparison.advantage1Desc: All bookings in one system. Automatic calendar sync. Reduced scheduling errors.
ClinicComparison.advantage2Desc: Website answers common questions. Staff focuses on patients instead of repetitive DMs.
ClinicComparison.advantage3Desc: 24/7 booking availability. Automatic reminders reduce no-shows.
ClinicComparison.advantage4Desc: When customers search the clinic name, they find a clear, professional presence.
ClinicComparison.advantage5Desc: Patients feel more confident when they see structured information and professional online booking options.
ClinicComparison.conclusion: In today's Georgia, your online presence is part of your clinic's reputation. When patients hear about your clinic and search online, they should find something that reflects the quality of your work.
ClinicComparison.reflectionQuestion: Which clinic does your business resemble today?
ClinicComparison.reflectionNote: Digital organization doesn't replace your expertise—it ensures patients can find you and experience your professionalism from the first search.
